summary: Iteration 16 verification: coach signature + coach_name + team full-report PDF + Sono/Bem-estar chart. 10/10 new backend tests pass + 7/7 iteration 15 regression tests pass. Frontend flows fully verified: /equipa PDF DA EQUIPA downloads a valid multi-page PDF (equipa_Sporting_Futsal_Lisboa_2026-09-19.pdf, ASCII filename, %PDF magic), edit form exposes data-testid='team-coach-name' pre-filled with 'Pedro Pipa', signature upload/preview/remove UI works (upload-signature-{id}, team-signature-preview-{id}, remove-signature-{id}), coach name 'Treinador: Pedro Pipa' displayed on team card. /atletas/{id} shows 'SONO & BEM-ESTAR (60 DIAS)' section (data-testid='sleep-wellness-chart') with two Recharts lines and dual Y axes (1-5 Sono left, 1-10 Bem-estar right), data points visible on demo data. Athlete PDF contains 'ASSINADO POR' block + 'Pedro Pipa' coach name (verified via pypdf text extraction). Team full PDF has >= (1 + N) pages for N athletes. Player role gets 403 on both /api/teams/{id}/signature (upload) and /api/export/team/full-report.pdf. 2MB file-size limit enforced on signature upload. ASCII-only Content-Disposition preserved for both athlete and team PDFs (regression from it15).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~4300 lines — the split into modules (auth/teams/export/analytics) is overdue.
PUT /api/teams/{id} still requires the full TeamIn body (name/escalao/epoca) even for a partial update like coach_name — consider a TeamPatch model with all-Optional fields for a friendlier API.

Team full-PDF endpoint silently skips broken athlete sections (logging.exception) but never surfaces which athletes failed to the caller; consider returning a small warnings JSON header or including a failure list on the cover page.
Signature 2 MB limit check should ideally happen before reading the whole body into memory (currently reads then rejects); low priority.
